title: Vance the Guard
dek: An Eovar guard whose answers preserve one local view of commerce, privacy and suspicion.

facts.Record: Public scenes; later status not established

sources: Main quest-RP archive · message anchors below
NPC Master Registry and Recovery Map · recovery lead, checked against raw scenes
body:
An Eovar affiliation

Asked about background checks, Vance explicitly places himself in Eovar and describes personal freedom, privacy and commerce as local values. This directly supports an Eovar connection on Prima. The registry’s broader Pristinia label is not used to assign him to the town’s guard.

Judgment rather than certainty

He argues that a burned building supports a person’s account and considers it unlikely that someone became a planted traitor so quickly. He has not completed the background check being requested. His reasoning is a guard’s stated judgment, not proof of innocence or a universal statement of Eovar law.

A rough social voice

An earlier encounter with Camelia shows him speaking crudely about who belongs in the drinking place. Keeping that behavior in view avoids turning the guard into a neutral institutional narrator. His later position or fate is not established.

Recorded scenes

  • Vance’s encounter with Camelia
  • Vance identifies Eovar’s values
  • An unverified judgment about a possible spy
